Usage: provenance merge-jsonl [OPTIONS] <BASE> <OURS> <THEIRS>

Arguments:
  <BASE>    
  <OURS>    
  <THEIRS>  

Options:
      --output <OUTPUT>  
      --quiet            Drop the advisory notes commands print alongside their output, such as the warning that this repository has no shaping skills installed
      --path <PATH>      Repository path the merged result belongs at. Git merge drivers get three temporary files, so this is how the merge learns which record type the file holds and which write-time checks to re-apply
      --format <FORMAT>  [default: json] [possible values: json]
  -h, --help             Print help
